caption:
Some habits never needed a trend.

Most of these line up with what the NHS still recommends today, like moving every day and keeping a regular bedtime.

Number 7 might be the most underrated. Loneliness affects health so much that the UK appointed its first Minister for Loneliness in 2018. A five-minute chat over the fence counts.

Save this, and send it to someone whose nan was exactly like this.
